correctness.rationale: Checked the exact finite common-base Q=b^(mn) block-mass representation. Product Q-digit measures with differing one-letter marginals separate by the strong law on canonical expansions, with ambiguous endpoints null because all digit weights are strictly positive and less than one. If masses agree, independence across both coprime partitions forces every proper split of the m- and n-blocks to factor; induction and CRT force a unique identical b-digit marginal w. Sufficiency is regrouping one b-Bernoulli process. Nonempty cylinders have positive mass, so support is all [0,1]. A separate exact 2-vs-3 binary-block rational test checked every 64 Q-cylinder mass; finite check did not replace the arbitrary-parameter proof.
